title: SAF Personnel Suffering from Psychiatric Ailment during or after Deployment Overseas
what_it_is: SAF Personnel Suffering from Psychiatric Ailment during or after Deployment Overseas

sections.label: PTSD incidence among SAF personnel
sections.summary: One serviceman was diagnosed with PTSD after deployment, and psychological disorder incidence among deployed SAF personnel is not higher than others.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Only one serviceman was diagnosed to have developed PTSD after his deployment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The incidence of all psychological disorders amongst SAF personnel on overseas deployment is not higher than SAF personnel in general or the incidence among the general population.

sections.label: Compensation for service-related psychological disorders
sections.summary: Compensation follows the overall framework for service injuries, with fully subsidised treatment at Government restructured hospitals, including after leaving SAF.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Compensation for psychiatric or psychological disorders follows that of the overall framework for injuries and disabilities arising from service.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Consults and treatment of affected personnel are fully subsidised at Government restructured hospitals, clinics and community hospitals, for as long as required, even after his term of service.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: For servicemen whose disorders were due to service but manifested after they have left the SAF, they are also eligible to the same terms of treatment.
